axis: +Y is up. +X follows the long trailing forms, and +Z faces southwest into the photographed clearing.

geometry.basis: The modeled bounds define the preview extent. The fan of arms and trailing form is reconstructed from photographs and the published plan. PMTiles supply the roads and terrain context.

orientationControl.basis: The 2016 survey identifies the western sculpture. The overhead film and north-up satellite imagery agree on the open side of the arm fan and the southeast trailing forms. The model’s torso is placed at the estimated fan hub, about 9 m northwest of the survey point, with local +Z facing about 225° true. The satellite streaks may include shadows. The compass bearing, outline and footing heights are approximate.

geometryLabel: Bounds of the authored sculpture in the aerial and PMTiles context
